name: Voice Pill
description: Compact microphone button that expands leftward into a recording pill with a live timer, scrolling waveform and slide-to-cancel, driven by a simulated voice signal or the real microphone.
contents: Round microphone button that swaps to a stop square while listening
Background pill that expands to the left on start
Elapsed time clock and canvas waveform bars
Cancel hint with arrow shown while sliding left
behavior: Tap toggles recording, press and hold records until release (mode auto, hold or tap)
Slide left while holding to cancel, with the timer and wave following the finger
Waveform and level follow a looping simulated speech pattern or the real microphone via Web Audio
Space and Enter toggle, Escape stops, losing window focus or hiding the tab stops recording
Press scale feedback and hover tint on fine pointers, reduced motion removes transforms and blur
editableByProps: Colors for accent, icon and pill background
Button size, shape, expansion reach and open duration
Show or hide timer, waveform and slide-to-cancel, and the cancel distance
Interaction mode, hold threshold, and simulated or real microphone input
Level response (attack, release, sensitivity, wave floor), press scale, disabled state and aria label

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the 'Cancel' label text or the mic icon
needsCodeEdit.where: Cancel span and Mic01Icon in the returned JSX

needsCodeEdit.change: Change waveform bar width, spacing or length of history
Make the pill expand to the right
needsCodeEdit.where: Background span inset and clip-path classes in the returned JSX

fixed: Pill always expands to the left, so it needs free space on its left side
Real microphone mode asks for browser permission, needs HTTPS and stops with a mic-denied reason if refused
Creates an AudioContext when mic mode is used and closes it on unmount
Cancel label text is hardcoded in English
Expanded width scales only with size, so very small containers on narrow screens may clip the expanded pill
